assessments.reasoning: The eight contiguous parts cover 130,871 bytes of the pinned SPDX json/details/GPL-3.0-only.json. Part 1 sets isDeprecatedLicenseId to false. Part 5 gives licenseId GPL-3.0-only, the name “GNU General Public License v3.0 only,” the distinguishing header and explanatory comments. Its seeAlso cites GNU's gpl-3.0-standalone.html and OSI's /license/GPL-3.0-only. Those links are leads, not separately inspected witnesses.

The SPDX repository's annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0. Its object.type is commit and object.sha is 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, matching the JSON locator. GitHub reports the tag unsigned. The repository record establishes its target without providing a signer attestation.

The pinned GNU text identifies version 3 in §0. Section 14 makes the later-version option conditional on what the program specifies. The appendix illustrates the other election, which explains why a match to the publisher document alone cannot select GPL-3.0-only. SPDX supplies the identifier.

limitations: The correspondence is conditional on the actual notice for the code. Both proposed correspondence records leave the structured conditions array empty and share the same publisher edition. Reading their keys as unconditional aliases would lose the distinction their statements expressly preserve.

SPDX matching templates and example headers describe how to recognize the election. A source file's own notice supplies the grant and its scope. A copy of the license body, one file's header, or a proposed active Index state cannot establish a project-wide election.
reasoning: SPDX License List 3.29.0 lists GPL-3.0-only for code whose applicable notice grants GNU GPL version 3 alone. The standard header ends the election with “version 3.” The claim's “alone” accurately describes that election even though the header does not literally say “alone” or “only.”
